entities.summary: Dr. Tatiana Vladimirovna Egorova (1930–2007) was a Russian botanist and author noted for working at the Saint Petersburg Botanical Garden and for editing the multi-volume Plants of Central Asia series. She described over 170 species, most in the genus Carex. The standard author abbreviation T.V.Egorova is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
